title: Long ASML — EUV Monopoly Picks-and-Shovels
entry: Scale in on any 3-5% pullback to $1,030-$1,050. Initial 50% sizing on entry; add remaining 50% if it pulls to $1,000 or breaks above $1,120 with volume confirmation.
stop_loss: $960 daily close (~12% below entry — wider stop for longer horizon)
catalyst: Every advanced semi node — Blackwell, Rubin, Apple A20, AMD Instinct, Samsung HBM4 — requires ASML's EUV lithography. No competitor exists. NVDA's $91B Q2 guide directly increases TSMC's wafer demand, which directly drives ASML's machine orders 18-24 months out.
thesis: ASML is the only company that makes EUV lithography machines, the irreplaceable input to every chip below 7nm. As long as the world wants more compute — and NVDA just confirmed that demand has gone 'parabolic' — ASML's order book grows. This is the cleanest 'picks-and-shovels' trade on the entire AI capex cycle: instead of betting which AI chip wins (NVDA vs AMD vs custom silicon), you bet that ALL of them get made — and all of them require ASML's machines. The High-NA EUV cycle is just beginning; the first commercial High-NA orders ramp in 2027, with TSMC, Samsung, and Intel all queued. ASML guided 2026 revenue $36-38B with EUV systems sold up 60% YoY. The Beijing export-license shoe is already in the price. Lower volatility than NVDA (~25% IV vs 40%+); cleaner compounder. Use NVDA-driven semi rallies as the entry catalyst rather than chasing NVDA directly.
bull_case: TSMC's 2nm ramp pulls forward; Samsung commits to 2nm production by H2 2027 — both require additional High-NA EUV orders. AI capex cycle extends through 2028. ASML hits $40B revenue 2026, $46B 2027, $52B 2028. Multiple re-rates from 35x to 42x forward earnings. Stock at $1,500+ within 12 months. Geopolitical tail: any easing of US-China semi restrictions reopens the China revenue channel (~10% of book), adding $4-5B annualized.
bear_case: China export restrictions tighten further — Dutch government pressured to expand the ban from EUV to advanced DUV, costing ASML another 5-10% of revenue. Hyperscaler capex cycle peaks H2 2026, order push-outs hit 2027 backlog. Multiple compresses to 30x as 'capex cycle' narrative reverses. Stock to $900 (-17%) in a hard-landing scenario. Tail risk: TSMC Taiwan disruption (geopolitical) breaks the entire revenue model.
invalidation: Daily close below $960 — implies broader semi capex thesis is breaking

outcome.outcome_label: All targets exceeded — ASML NASDAQ at $1,549.71
outcome.note: ASML (NASDAQ) closed at $1,549.71 on May 20, 2026 (+6.21% on the session), decisively exceeding all three targets ($1,200, $1,350, $1,500). The EUV monopoly thesis played out ahead of the 3-12 month horizon; NVDA's $91B Q2 guide accelerated TSMC's wafer demand forecasts and pulled ASML's order book re-rating forward. Return computed from reference current_price ($1,085) to Target 3 ($1,500): +38.2%. The fundamental thesis — ASML as the irreplaceable picks-and-shovels of the AI compute cycle — remains intact; the position is closed at the target on price, not thesis.
